newsitem.title: USA: Ill. University board approves expansion planners.
newsitem.headline: Ill. University board approves expansion planners.

text.p: University of Illinois board of regents approved the selection of a consortium of developers to plan up to $400 million expansion of University of Illinois at Chicago.
Board members unanimously approved the selection of a group including Mesirow Stein Real Estate Inc as master developer for the campus expansion at their meeting Thursday, UIC spokesman Ed Tate said.
The consortium also includes New Frontier Cos headed by William Cellini.
The South Campus Development Team LLC has an 18-month $731,000 contract to create the master plan for the development on land once occupied by the Maxwell Street market west of downtown Chicago.
The university hopes to include a chemistry building, business school, office building, student housing and performing arts center in the expansion.
Groundbreaking for the first buildings would be held in early 2000 under the basic development plan.
